name: Web Design & Development
shortDesc: Stunning, high-performance websites that convert visitors into customers.
description: We build pixel-perfect, fully responsive websites using modern HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. From corporate sites to complex web applications, every project is crafted with performance, SEO, and user experience at its core.

name: Mobile App Development
shortDesc: Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android that users love.
description: From concept to App Store, we build mobile applications that are fast, intuitive, and beautifully designed. We specialize in React Native and Flutter for cross-platform apps, and native Swift/Kotlin for premium performance.

name: UI/UX Design
shortDesc: Research-driven design that delights users and drives business results.
description: Great products start with great design. Our UX team conducts user research, creates wireframes, and delivers high-fidelity Figma prototypes that bring your vision to life before a single line of code is written.

name: E-Commerce Solutions
shortDesc: Powerful online stores that sell 24/7 with seamless payment integration.
description: We build high-converting e-commerce platforms on WooCommerce, Shopify, and custom stacks. From product catalog to checkout optimization, we ensure your store is built to maximize revenue.

name: Cloud & Infrastructure
shortDesc: Scalable, secure cloud infrastructure that grows with your business.
description: We architect and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Google Cloud, and DigitalOcean. From serverless deployments to containerized microservices, we ensure your applications are fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.

name: SEO & Digital Marketing
shortDesc: Data-driven campaigns that put your brand in front of the right audience.
description: Our digital marketing team combines technical SEO, content strategy, and paid advertising to deliver measurable results. We help businesses rank higher, reach more customers, and grow revenue.

name: Custom Software Development
shortDesc: Bespoke software solutions engineered for your unique business needs.
description: When off-the-shelf software isn't enough, we build custom solutions. From ERP systems to industry-specific platforms, our engineering team delivers robust, scalable software that solves real business problems.

name: Brand Identity Design
shortDesc: Memorable brand identities that tell your story and build lasting recognition.
description: A powerful brand is the foundation of every successful business. We create complete visual identities including logos, color systems, typography, and brand guidelines that make you unforgettable.
